conventions.time: Seconds from the start of the audio file.
conventions.bar: 1-based. Bar 1 starts at the first downbeat; beats before it form a pickup, bar 0.
conventions.beat_in_bar: 1-based position in the bar; 1 is the downbeat.
conventions.beat_ranges: 'beat a to beat b' is half-open [a, b): from the start of beat a to the start of beat b.
conventions.bar_ranges: 'bars a-b' is inclusive of both bars.
conventions.track_end: Beat position N (= number of beats) is the end of the file; the last beat runs to the end.

confidence_detail.how: 0.6*beat_support + 0.25*downbeat_agreement + 0.15*exp(-fit_rms_ms/20). A heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
